items.sum: 生态环境部 11 月 9 日发布通知（环办气候函〔2026〕428 号），发布《温室气体自愿减排项目方法学 乔木林经营碳汇（CCER—13—001—V01）》与《更新造林碳汇（CCER—14—006—V01）》，自印发之日起施行；明确项目减排量归林木所有权人，项目须取得寿命期内不皆伐承诺，省级生态环境与林草部门负责监督检查与举报查处。文件落款 2026-11-04。
items.sum_en: The Ministry of Ecology and Environment released a notice (No. 428 of 2026) on Nov 9, publishing the greenhouse gas voluntary emission reduction project methodologies 'Forest Management Carbon Sink (CCER-13-001-V01)' and 'Updated Afforestation Carbon Sink (CCER-14-006-V01)', effective from the date of issuance. Emission reductions belong to forest owners, projects must secure a commitment not to clear-cut during their lifetime, and provincial ecology and forestry departments supervise inspections and handle reports. The document is dated Nov 4, 2026.
items.title: 生态环境部等发布两项 CCER 方法学（乔木林经营碳汇、更新造林碳汇）
items.title_en: MEE releases two CCER methodologies on forest carbon sinks

items.sum: 财政部 11 月 9 日宣布，对美加征 24% 关税暂停期延长两个月，自 11 月 10 日 13:01 生效至 2027 年 1 月 10 日，10% 加征关税保留；若无延期，11 月 10 日起将恢复 34% 总税率。税委会称此举落实中美华盛顿峰会共识。
items.sum_en: The Ministry of Finance (MOF) announced on Nov 9 that the suspension of the 24% additional tariff on US goods will be extended by two months and enter into force at 13:01 on Nov 10, running until Jan 10, 2027, while the 10% additional tariff remains in place; without an extension, the total rate would return to 34% from Nov 10. The Tariff Commission said the move implements the consensus of the China-US Washington summit.
items.title: 中国延缓对美加征 24% 关税两个月，10% 关税保留
items.title_en: China extends 24% tariff suspension on US goods by two months, keeps 10% duty

During the suspension, exporters must apply for licences under the Regulations on Export Control of Dual-Use Items.

items.sum: 欧洲议会环境委员会以 48 票赞成、30 票反对、2 票弃权通过谈判立场：乘用车 2035 年 CO₂ 减排目标由较 2021 年降 100% 降至 87.5%，低碳钢积分最高可抵 7.5%；货车 2035 年目标降至 80%、2030 年目标由现行 50% 降至 35%（低于欧委会提议的 40%）；过渡期积分上限 3%。委员会表决 2026-11-04，全体表决预计 12 月，其后与理事会谈判；现行规则目前未变。
items.sum_en: The European Parliament's Committee on the Environment adopted its negotiating position by 48 votes to 30, with 2 abstentions: the 2035 CO2 reduction target for passenger cars falls from 100% to 87.5% against 2021 levels, with low-carbon steel credits offsetting up to 7.5%; the 2035 target for trucks falls to 80% and the 2030 target to 35%, down from the current 50% and below the European Commission's proposed 40%; credits in the transition period are capped at 3%. The committee voted on Nov 4, 2026; a plenary vote is expected in December, followed by negotiations with the Council; current rules remain unchanged.
items.title: 欧洲议会环境委员会通过 2035 年汽车 CO₂ 目标谈判立场
items.title_en: European Parliament environment committee adopts negotiating position on 2035 car CO2 targets

items.sum: 捷克储能制造商 GAZ Energy 10 月 29 日宣布与数字护照服务商 Minespider 合作，为其工业电池系统建立数字电池护照：每套系统设永久 ID，护照汇集产品、制造商、合规与生命周期信息，客户通过 QR 码等载体访问，API 支持投运后持续更新；产品文档、合规、循环与运行数据按公开与受限分层共享。GAZ 在建与已交付项目合计超 2GWh，分布于德国、芬兰、捷克、波兰、斯洛伐克、罗马尼亚。2027 年 2 月 18 日起，欧盟市场每块 2kWh 以上工业电池须配数字护照。
items.sum_en: GAZ Energy, a Czech energy storage manufacturer, announced on Oct 29 that it is working with battery passport provider Minespider to build digital battery passports for its industrial battery systems: each system gets a permanent ID, and its passport brings together product, manufacturer, compliance and life cycle information, accessible via carriers such as QR codes, with API connections keeping the record updated after commissioning; product documentation, compliance, circularity and operating data are shared through public and restricted-access layers. GAZ Energy's projects total more than 2 GWh across Germany, Finland, Czechia, Poland, Slovakia and Romania. From Feb 18, 2027, every industrial battery above 2 kWh sold in the EU needs a DPP.
items.title: 捷克 GAZ Energy 与 Minespider 合作建设电池护照
items.title_en: Czechia's GAZ Energy teams up with Minespider to build battery passports

items.sum: T&E 分析称，纯电动车占全球车队 4.2%、占新车销量 25%（五年前 6.6%），日均替代石油 120 万桶（2021 年 21.5 万桶），年减排超 2 亿吨 CO₂e；电动公交与卡车另替代约 32 万桶/日。T&E 称按现行政策，2034 年纯电乘用车日均替代量可达 580 万桶。
items.sum_en: T&E analysis says battery-electric vehicles account for 4.2% of the global vehicle fleet and 25% of new car sales, up from 6.6% five years ago, displacing 1.2 million barrels of oil per day, up from 215,000 barrels in 2021, and cutting more than 200 million tonnes of CO2e per year; electric buses and trucks displace about another 320,000 barrels per day. T&E says that under current policies, battery-electric passenger cars could displace 5.8 million barrels per day by 2034.
items.title: T&E：全球电动车石油替代量五年增至五倍
items.title_en: T&E: EVs displace five times more oil globally than five years ago

items.sum: 文章对比鞍钢、河钢、宝武、山钢四套碳核算平台与欧盟 CBAM、worldsteel、日韩 MRV 制度：国内头部钢企核算已到工序/钢卷/测点级、月度甚至实时，欧盟 CBAM 正式期仍按装置、前体逐级追溯、年度申报；CBAM 证书价 2026 年一季度 75.36 欧元/吨、二季度 75.28 欧元/吨，同期国内碳价约 80 元/吨。
items.sum_en: The article compares the carbon accounting platforms of Ansteel, HBIS, Baowu and Shandong Steel with the EU CBAM, worldsteel and Japanese and Korean MRV systems: leading Chinese steelmakers already account at process, coil and measurement-point level, monthly or even in real time, while the EU CBAM in its definitive phase still requires traceability by installation and precursor and files annual declarations; CBAM certificate prices were EUR 75.36 per tonne in the first quarter of 2026 and EUR 75.28 in the second quarter, against about CNY 80 per tonne in China.
items.title: 碳排放核算平台对比：宝武月算 33 万卷钢，欧盟按年度核查
items.title_en: Carbon accounting platforms compared: Baowu calculates 330,000 steel coils a month, EU verification runs annually

items.sum: 福特 11 月 9 日公布 2021 款 Mustang Mach-E 首批车主五年实测数据：约 36,000 辆车、累计 20 亿英里全电动里程，平均电池健康度 92%（可用容量），95% 的车辆在 87% 至 97% 之间；超 2,000 名车主原装电池行驶超 100,000 英里、平均健康度高于 91%，超 30 名车主行驶超 200,000 英里、平均 88%。数据截至 2026 年 8 月，覆盖美国与加拿大零售及车队客户；福特全系纯电车型电池包设计寿命至少 10 年，100,000 英里时平均保持大于 90% 的健康度。
items.sum_en: Ford released on Nov 9 five-year real-world data from first owners of the 2021 Mustang Mach-E: about 36,000 vehicles covering 2 billion all-electric miles, with average battery health of 92% of usable capacity and 95% of vehicles between 87% and 97%; more than 2,000 owners have driven over 100,000 miles on the original battery at above 91% average health, and more than 30 owners have passed 200,000 miles at 88% on average. The data run to August 2026 and cover retail and fleet customers in the US and Canada; Ford's all-electric line-up is designed for a battery pack life of at least 10 years, retaining above 90% average health at 100,000 miles.
items.title: 福特 Mustang Mach-E 五年电池健康数据：平均保持率 92%
items.title_en: Ford releases five-year Mustang Mach-E battery health data: 92% average retention

items.sum: 宝马 11 月 9 日宣布，三星 SDI 将在欧洲、LG 新能源将在美国为其第六代圆柱电芯供货，2020 年代末开始交付，用于 Neue Klasse 车型（含下一代 iX3）；欧洲此前 CATL 与亿纬锂能占 Gen6 全部份额，现增至三家供应商；美国 LG 新能源加入 Envision AESC 的供货行列。宝马未披露合同金额与供货量；三星 SDI 在匈牙利格德工厂供货，LG 新能源在美国现有工厂生产；宝马同时在南卡罗来纳州伍德拉夫投资 7 亿美元建设高压电池组装中心。
items.sum_en: BMW announced on Nov 9 that Samsung SDI will supply its sixth-generation cylindrical cells in Europe and LG Energy Solution in the US, with deliveries starting in the late 2020s for Neue Klasse models including the next-generation iX3; CATL and EVE Energy previously held all of BMW's European Gen6 volume, which now rises to three suppliers, while LG Energy Solution joins Envision AESC on the US supply roster. BMW disclosed no contract values or volumes; Samsung SDI will supply from its plant in Goed, Hungary, and LG Energy Solution from its existing US plants; BMW is also investing USD 700 million in a high-voltage battery assembly centre in Woodruff, South Carolina.
items.title: 宝马新增三星 SDI 与 LG 新能源为 Gen6 电芯供应商
items.title_en: BMW adds Samsung SDI and LG Energy Solution as Gen6 cell suppliers

items.sum: LG 新能源、三星 SDI、SK On 加速将北美闲置汽车电芯产能转作公用事业级储能：LG 新能源目标 2026 年底北美储能电芯产能 50GWh（占其全球储能目标 60GWh 的 83%），在手订单 160GWh；三星 SDI 印第安纳 StarPlus 合资厂 2026 年 10 月初投产，储能订单超 60GWh、产能已订满至 2028 年，另有两条汽车产线 2027 年上半年起转产；SK On 改造韩国西山与美国佐治亚州 Commerce 工厂部分产线，8 月与 NeoVolta 签 9GWh 储能供货协议（2027—2031 年）。美国 301 关税与 45X 制造抵免（35 美元/千瓦时）推动需求转向本土产能。
items.sum_en: LG Energy Solution, Samsung SDI and SK On are accelerating the conversion of idle North American automotive cell capacity to utility-scale energy storage: LG Energy Solution targets 50 GWh of North American storage cell capacity by the end of 2026 (83% of its 60 GWh global storage target), with a 160 GWh order backlog; Samsung SDI's StarPlus joint venture plant in Indiana began production in early October 2026, holds more than 60 GWh of storage orders with capacity booked through 2028, and will convert two more automotive lines from the first half of 2027; SK On is retooling lines at Seosan in Korea and Commerce, Georgia, and signed a 9 GWh storage supply agreement with NeoVolta in August (2027–2031). Section 301 tariffs and the Section 45X manufacturing credit (USD 35 per kWh) are shifting demand to domestic capacity.
items.title: 韩系三家转产美国储能产线，LG 新能源年底北美储能产能 50GWh
items.title_en: Korean cell makers shift US lines to grid storage; LG targets 50 GWh by year-end

items.sum: EcoPro Innovation 与澳大利亚 Pursuit Minerals 签约，向其阿根廷 Salta 省 Rio Grande Sur 锂项目投入 4000 万美元：2000 万美元入股运营子公司 20%，另 2000 万美元为预付款贷款；一期设计年产 5000 吨电池级碳酸锂当量，EcoPro 获一期全部包销权；项目总资源量 110.4 万吨碳酸锂当量，一期资本开支约 1.2 亿美元。协议目前为非约束性谅解备忘录，须完成法律与技术尽职调查后签署正式协议。
items.sum_en: EcoPro Innovation signed an agreement with Australia's Pursuit Minerals to invest USD 40 million in its Rio Grande Sur lithium project in Salta Province, Argentina: USD 20 million for a 20% equity stake in the operating subsidiary plus a USD 20 million prepayment loan; The initial phase is designed to produce 5,000 tonnes of battery-grade lithium carbonate equivalent per year, with EcoPro taking all initial-phase off-take; the project holds a total resource of 1.104 million tonnes of lithium carbonate equivalent, and initial-phase capital expenditure is about USD 120 million. The agreement is currently a non-binding memorandum of understanding, with binding agreements to follow a legal and technical due diligence investigation.
items.title: EcoPro Innovation 投资 4000 万美元开发阿根廷锂项目
items.title_en: EcoPro Innovation invests USD 40 million in Argentine lithium project

items.sum_en: Brazil's National Committee for the Industrialisation of Critical and Strategic Minerals approved a list of 27 critical minerals on Nov 5, in three tiers: 9 high-priority (rare earths, graphite, lithium, nickel, cobalt, copper, manganese, silicon, uranium), 8 medium and 10 low; only listed minerals and projects with national registration qualify for federal support; a FGAM fund of up to BRL 2 billion (about USD 364 million) was also created, and the federal critical minerals programme will fund up to BRL 1 billion per year in 2030–2034.
items.title: 巴西确定 27 种关键矿产清单
items.title_en: Brazil names 27 critical minerals in three tiers

items.sum: 美方 11 月 6 日要求对海军舰艇中国稀土做紧急审计，涉导弹制导、核潜艇等关键组件，中国供应占比 70%—95%；每艘弗吉尼亚级核潜艇用稀土约 9200 磅。DFARS 252.225-7052 规定 2027 年 1 月 1 日起国防承包商须停购中国钕、钐钴、钨、钽；非中国磁材采购溢价 20%—30%。
items.sum_en: The US on Nov 6 ordered an urgent audit of Chinese rare earths in naval vessels, covering missile guidance, nuclear submarines and other critical components, with China supplying 70%–95%; each Virginia-class nuclear submarine uses about 9,200 pounds of rare earths. DFARS 252.225-7052 requires defence contractors to stop buying Chinese neodymium, samarium-cobalt, tungsten and tantalum from Jan 1, 2027; non-Chinese magnet materials carry a 20%–30% price premium.
items.title: 美国防部要求造船厂 2027 年前清除中国稀土
items.title_en: Pentagon orders shipyards to purge Chinese rare earths before 2027

items.sum: 白宫 11 月 8 日加速审查，将联邦关键矿产资金从上游开采转向盟友精炼冶炼；韩国锌业田纳西 Clarksville 冶炼厂（Project Crucible）获 2.1 亿美元 CHIPS 法案拨款，总投资 74 亿美元，年产 54 万吨精炼金属（含 11 种关键矿产），2029 年投产、2030 年满产。
items.sum_en: The White House on Nov 8 accelerated a review redirecting federal critical-minerals funding from upstream mining to allied refining and smelting; Korea Zinc's Clarksville, Tennessee smelter (Project Crucible) received a USD 210 million CHIPS Act grant, with total investment of USD 7.4 billion, annual output of 540,000 tonnes of refined metals (including 11 critical minerals), production starting in 2029 and full output in 2030.
items.title: 美国转向资助盟友精炼：韩国锌业 74 亿美元田纳西冶炼厂
items.title_en: US shifts mineral funding to allied refining; Korea Zinc's USD 7.4 billion Tennessee smelter

items.sum: 美国土地管理局（BLM）11 月 3 日致函认定，Century Lithium 内华达州 Angel Island 锂项目的矿山运营计划与复垦许可申请完备，项目进入《国家环境政策法》（NEPA）环评阶段；后续须完成供水管线基线研究，BLM 再定环评为环境评估或环境影响报告书；项目为 FAST-41 透明项目，联邦许可看板显示裁决目标 2028 年 2 月 4 日。
items.sum_en: The US Bureau of Land Management (BLM) wrote on Nov 3 that the Mine Plan of Operations and reclamation permit application for Century Lithium's Angel Island lithium project in Nevada are complete, moving the project into environmental review under the National Environmental Policy Act (NEPA); baseline studies for the water-supply pipeline remain to be completed before BLM decides between an Environmental Assessment and an Environmental Impact Statement (environmental impact report); the project is a FAST-41 Transparency Project, and the federal Permitting Dashboard shows a target date of Feb 4, 2028 for the Record of Decision.
items.title: Century Lithium 内华达锂矿计划获完备认定，进入环评
items.title_en: Century Lithium's Angel Island mine plan deemed complete, advancing to environmental review

items.sum: American Rare Earths 11 月 9 日宣布，怀俄明 Halleck Creek 矿精矿已交付 Novex 公司，小规模连续中试厂开工，分三阶段生产钕镨氧化物、再转为钕镨金属样品，验证从精矿到分离氧化物再到金属的中游环节；计划 2027 年一季度完成，成果用于萨斯喀彻温研究理事会更大规模示范厂设计；产量为示范量，非商业生产。
items.sum_en: American Rare Earths announced on Nov 9 that rare earth concentrate from its Halleck Creek deposit in Wyoming has been delivered to Novex, LLC, and work has begun on a small-scale continuous pilot plant to produce neodymium-praseodymium (NdPr) oxide and then convert it into NdPr metal samples, demonstrating the midstream step from concentrate to separated oxide to metal; the programme is due to finish in the first quarter of 2027, with results informing a larger demonstration plant at the Saskatchewan Research Council; output is at demonstration scale, not commercial production.
items.title: American Rare Earths 启动美国钕镨金属中试
items.title_en: American Rare Earths starts US pilot plant for NdPr oxide and metal

items.source: International Mining
items.sum: IGO 11 月 9 日确认，西澳 Nova 镍矿开采加工结束：末期镍产量 21,340 吨，较修订指引上限高约 7%，铜 9,517 吨、钴 765 吨，现金成本 3.90 澳元/磅可付镍；矿山运营近十年后到达计划寿命终点；IGO 正推进以 700 万澳元将 Nova 售予 Global Lithium Resources，厂房拟转作 Manna 锂项目。
items.sum_en: IGO confirmed on Nov 9 that mining and processing at the Nova nickel operation in Western Australia have concluded: final-period nickel output was 21,340 tonnes, about 7% above the top of the guidance range following its revision, with copper at 9,517 tonnes and cobalt at 765 tonnes and cash costs of A$3.90 per pound of payable nickel; the mine reached the end of its planned life after almost a decade of production; IGO is progressing the A$7 million divestment of Nova to Global Lithium Resources, which plans to repurpose the plant for its Manna Lithium Project.
items.title: IGO 结束 Nova 镍矿开采，末期产量超指引
items.title_en: IGO ends mining at Nova nickel operation after beating production guidance

items.sum: 格林美 11 月 2 日在维也纳与联合国工业发展组织（UNIDO）签署联合宣言，围绕绿色技术创新与示范、政策对话与知识共享等四大方向，深化循环经济与电池领域关键矿产合作。宣言于 11 月 9 日刊于格林美官网新闻列表。
items.sum_en: GEM signed a joint declaration with the United Nations Industrial Development Organization (UNIDO) in Vienna on Nov 2, covering four areas including green technology innovation and demonstration, policy dialogue and knowledge sharing, to deepen cooperation on the circular economy and critical minerals for batteries. The declaration appeared on GEM's website news list on Nov 9.
items.title: 格林美与 UNIDO 签署联合宣言，深化循环经济与电池关键矿产合作
items.title_en: GEM signs joint declaration with UNIDO on circular economy and battery minerals

items.sum: 工信部节能与综合利用司 10 月 12 日启动 2026 年度再生资源综合利用规范条件企业申报，废塑料规模门槛：PET 再生瓶片及破碎清洗分选新建≥3 万吨/年、已建≥2 万吨/年，造粒新建≥5000 吨/年、已建≥3000 吨/年；入选企业可享增值税即征即退 70%，省级审核普遍要求 11 月 20 日前完成。
items.sum_en: MIIT's Energy Conservation and Comprehensive Utilisation Department launched the 2026 declaration for enterprises meeting the standard conditions for comprehensive utilisation of renewable resources on Oct 12: for waste plastics, the scale thresholds are 30,000 tonnes per year for new PET recycled flake and crushing/cleaning/sorting capacity (20,000 for existing), and 5,000 tonnes per year for new pelletising capacity (3,000 for existing); selected enterprises qualify for a 70% VAT refund on collection, and provincial reviews are generally due by Nov 20.
items.title: 废塑料规范条件企业申报：省级审核 11 月 20 日前完成
items.title_en: Waste plastics standard-conditions declaration: provincial reviews due by Nov 20

overview: 本期覆盖2026年11月9日（北京时间），共收录22条，其中正式收录4条、一句话18条。合规侧以欧洲议会环境委员会通过2035年汽车CO₂目标谈判立场、捷克GAZ Energy电池护照落地、中美经贸措施两月暂停三则为核心；方法侧仅碳核算平台对比一条；产业侧以宝马Gen6新增韩系电芯供应商、韩系三家转产美国储能、福特Mustang Mach-E五年电池健康数据为主，另有巴西关键矿产清单、美国稀土与精炼动向、宁德时代海外出货等。
